description: For a PDF, picture or spreadsheet (up to 25 MB). Call with filename, content_type and size: you get an address to PUT the file to. After the PUT, call again with document_id: Guest Logic reads it and returns what was found. Types: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, XLSX, XLS, CSV, TXT. Needs the owner's sign-in.
